title: Saumarez Homestead
geometryBasis: The named OpenStreetMap way 583441451 fixes the 34-corner main-house footprint. Damien Linnane’s October 2014 CC0 photograph establishes the northwest projecting brick gables, decorated trim, paired upper windows, green corrugated roofs and open verandas.
sectionBasis: The original lawn sample outside the northwest elevation sets model zero. Set the verandas and brick sill above the adjacent grade, then estimate the floor, eaves and ridge from the visible proportions. Foundation geometry extends into the original grade.
limitations: October 2014 exterior of the principal house and its attached ranges. Detached farm buildings and interiors are outside scope.
The northwest elevation is based on the cleared photograph. Rear and side elevations, roof joins, absolute heights and fine decorative joinery are estimates.
Original terrain samples are preserved. Foundation and entrance step heights use the original grade near the photographed northwest elevation.
